description: Code 128 and EAN-13 barcode generators — pure LOOK, no native code and no external service. Code 128 encodes printable-ASCII (SKUs, order ids, short URLs) with automatic code-set switching; EAN-13 renders the 13-digit retail product code (GTIN-13) with its mod-10 check digit and the classic human-readable number. Self-contained SVG, verified module-for-module against python-barcode.
author: codlook
